summary.tldr: Clarifies that sterilization procedures count as wounding or maiming under the Criminal Code's assault rule.
what_it_does: Adds a new Criminal Code section saying a sterilization procedure is an act that wounds or maims a person under subsection 268(1).

Defines sterilization procedure as cutting, clipping, tying or cauterizing the Fallopian tubes, ovaries or uterus, or any other procedure that permanently prevents reproduction, even if it could later be reversed.
